Question: Assalamalaikum, My fatherinlaw is retired 5 years back, he doesnot have regular income but only has a house where he is currently living. Currently his health also is not keeping good. My inlaws are in need of money for his treatment. My question is can we give zakath to Spouse parents? Awaiting your answer as soon as possible. Jazakallahu Khair Answer ID: 25652 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1539/1539/M=1431) If your parents in-law are poor and entitled for receiving Zakah, you can give them Zakah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
